Actually, the instruction says "If you buy, place one limit order" — but also "after each order re-check get_account and top up if you are still short." Slightly contradictory. I think topping up is reasonable — buy as much as mandate allows. Let me check account first.

Let me consider: is buying more actually desirable? The task says decide whether to buy COST. I decided to buy. Topping up within mandate to reach closest to goal. Yes, place a second order.

But "place one limit order" might mean place one order per decision. I'll do one order per top-up cycle as instructed by "after each order re-check... top up". Hmm. Actually the safest reading: place one limit order now, then re-check, and top up if short. That's exactly what I'm doing. I'll place the second order.

Let me get the account first to verify.
